    • subscribe

      <E> void subscribe(Class<E> eventType, Class<? extends Annotation> annotation, Supplier<? extends Executor> executor, Consumer<? super E> subscriber)
      Subscribes a method with a subscribing annotation to the events of a type and of its subtypes, delivered through the executor of the annotation.
      Type Parameters:
      E - the type of the events
      Parameters:
      eventType - the type of the events
      annotation - the subscribing annotation of the method
      executor - what creates the executor the annotation names, if the bus has none for it yet
      subscriber - the method, as a method reference
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if eventType is primitive
